benchmarks.name: Traditional Chinese Quality Benchmark
benchmarks.summary: Measures how clean a tool's Traditional Chinese output is against Taiwan usage norms: simplified-character residue, mainland-China wording, and terminology consistency. Fixed 24-segment corpus (marketing, UI strings, game dialogue, customer support), deterministic scoring script, raw outputs archived per run.

runs.conditions: AI/LLM engines received the corpus with one shared neutral prompt ('Translate into Traditional Chinese as used in Taiwan' plus fixed formatting instructions). Machine-translation engines received the source text directly, with no prompt. The groups were measured under different conditions; this disclosure travels with the scores wherever they appear.
